title: MeshJobDescriptor
description:
Mesh job descriptor.

Encapsulates all parameters needed to execute a job on a node. The hub or orchestrator sends this to a node via HTTP/gRPC, and the node's runtime (NodeDataPlane) dispatches it to the appropriate handler.

governance_context.description: Governance context (optional): requesting node ID, reason, etc.

job_id.description: Unique job ID (assigned by hub or caller).

parameters.description:
Type-specific parameters (JSON blob).

For `EvalDataset`: `{ "dataset_name": "...", "top_k": 10 }` For `AnalyticsQuery`: `{ "query_type": "ncit_summary", "filters": {...} }` For `MappingHealthCheck`: `{}`

MeshJobType.description:
Mesh job type.

Defines the category of work being requested. Each type corresponds to a specific set of parameters in `MeshJobDescriptor`.

oneOf.description: Run an eval dataset against the mapping pipeline.
Execute an analytics query (NCIt summary, cohort).
Perform a mapping health check (verify pipeline/vector runtime).
Export aggregated data (with DP noise, if required).
